Proof of governance

Principles that can be verified

Determinism before intelligence: the model enters only where Rules aren't enough. Deterministic-first: the model acts only on the residue That rules don't work.

Determinism

The same entry produces the same output. Non-determinism is isolated at one point Named system, and that point is testable.

Auditability

Every automated decision holds the evidence that sustained it, in a format that a Third can rerun.

Traceability

From a production behavior it is possible to reach the specification line that the demanded, and the approval that released him.

Reversibility

No change enters without a known and exercised return path. Rollback not tested is not rollback.

In short

AI complexity, structured for auditing

Three systems — institutional memory without hallucination, specification as contract and continuous resilience mat — presented in two readings of the same truth: the executive, measure in risk and return, and the engineering, measure in coverage and latency.

  • GraphRAG and ontologies — the AI's response comes from the company's memory, with a path from provenance to node.
  • Spec-Driven Development — what has been approved is exactly what comes into production; the change goes back to spec, never straight to the code.
  • DevOps Salesforce — single and supervised delivery path, with known and exercised rollback.
  • Determinism, auditability, traceability and reversibility — four principles declared verifiable, not decorative.

Profound in Trust Engineering and AI Agent Engineering.

Frequently Asked Questions

Frequently Asked Questions

What makes an AI architecture auditable?

The ability to reconstruct, for any output, the evidence that sustained it: what sources were consulted, under which version of the specification, with which approval. Auditability is not a report produced afterwards — it is the byproduct of a single decision and delivery path.

What is GraphRAG and why reduce hallucination?

It is the recovery of context from a graph of knowledge with typed relations, rather than just similarity of text. As each response carries the nodes covered, there is verifiable provenance; and since the absence of data is treated as explicit uncertainty (open-world), the system prefers not to respond to invent.

What is Spec-Driven Development in practice?

The specification is the source of truth and the executable target: Acceptance criteria have seen tests, and any behavior change passes first by spec. A criterion is only valid if it can fail — "improving performance" is not a criterion, "p95 below 400 ms" is.

What governance principles are declared?

Determinism (same entry, same output, with isolated and testable non-determinism), auditability (all decision holds re-executable evidence), traceability (from production behavior to the specification line that required it) and reversibility (no change enters without back-execised path).

Why does the page have two perspectives?

Because the same architecture needs to be defended in two vocabularies: risk, governance and return to executive decision; ontologies, contracts and latency for engineering decision. Phrase pairs maintain identical syntactic structure and metrics — it is the same truth told in two ways, not two different statements.
